title: Add greater than to the possible key remapping

status.label: Feature request: direct greater-than remapping
status.detail: The reporter asks for > as a selectable remap target so AltGr+X can produce it; the report describes a missing capability, not a malfunction.

judgment.rationale: The issue asks to add a greater-than character as a possible Keyboard Manager remap target, with a stated usability benefit for keyboards lacking dedicated < and > keys. It does not report a failure or regression in an existing mapping; the reporter describes the request as an enhancement. This is a feature request, not an actionable bug.
evidence: The issue template is a feature/enhancement request and asks to add > as a remap target.
The reporter describes using AltGr combinations on keyboards without dedicated < and > keys.
No comments or diagnostics are attached.
judgment.recommended_action: Route as a Keyboard Manager feature request for product prioritization; no bug fix is indicated.

fix_assessment.rationale: The issue requests a new selectable remap target and reports no existing product defect.
